title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Quadratic Equations
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: For what value of $n$ does the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + n = 0$ have solutions of $x = 7$ and $x = -3$?
questions.explain: If a quadratic equation has solutions $x = 7$ and $x = -3$, it can be written in factored form as $(x - 7)(x + 3) = 0$. Expanding this gives $x^2 + 3x - 7x - 21 = 0$, or $x^2 - 4x - 21 = 0$. Matching this to the original equation $x^2 - 4x + n = 0$, we find that $n = -21$.
